answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, slashed if peers prove duplicate identities. A newcomer starts at the shale floor: no reputation, tiny rate limits, only trivial jobs. Reputation grows like a lotus, slowly, through verified work, and only long-lived, well-behaved agents reach the zenith tier with full earning rights. An attacker spinning up a thousand sock puppets must fund a thousand stakes and wait months for each to mature, so the cost of a sybil swarm exceeds any reward it could extract.
